evals.prompt: Design a replay trace that catches early and late long-note releases and verifies the tail judgement.
evals.expected_output: A song-time press/release trace design with validation, applied-event logs, and 7.55-derived assertions.
expectations: Includes both press and release events with explicit integer time units
Covers early, in-window, and late releases and hold state
Uses the inclusive 6/18/25 ms windows where applicable
Separates determinism checks from proof of 7.55 parity

evals.prompt: Make our input replay suite useful in CI where install-root and the Memoryer server do not exist.
evals.expected_output: A synthetic offline replay strategy with clean optional-data skips and separately enabled live tests.
expectations: Uses synthetic charts and portable input API injection for ordinary tests
Requires clean early skips for real-data tests without install-root
Keeps live gateway tests opt-in and separately reported
Uses null or virtual audio for automated runs
